backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with authorization and storing enquiries with admin-only retrieval and status updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping deployment-related requirements to files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of concise descriptions for many frontend files covering layout, sections, hooks, and configuration.
frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md: Documentation for the live deployment URL and instructions for updating and re-mapping the custom ICP0 domain.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md: Template updated during deployment to record the newest public URL and canister ID.
frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md: Guide for configuring Google Search Console using the current deployed canister URL and sitemap.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO metadata, social tags, fonts, and an empty og:url updated at runtime.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing full crawling and referencing sitemap via a relative path.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Minimal sitemap listing the root path with weekly change frequency.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app rendering marketing sections or admin enquiries view and updating og:url on startup.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component showing brand, contact links, quick navigation, and smooth-scroll handlers based on current view.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with logo, navigation links, mobile menu, and logic for scrolling to sections or switching views.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section displaying highlights of the counselling service with cards and icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact form with validation, enquiry submission via mutation, and static contact info display.
frontend/src/components/sections/Coverag: Coverage section outlining primary and secondary regions plus benefits of regional expertise.
frontend/src/components/sections/Enquiri: Admin-only enquiries viewer with login flow, permission checks, listing, and mark-as-answered actions.
frontend/src/components/sections/FaqSect: Displays an FAQ section using an accordion, mapping predefined questions and answers into expandable items.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the hero banner with headline, call‑to‑action buttons, stats, and a promotional image, including smooth‑scroll handlers.
frontend/src/components/sections/Process: Shows a five‑step admissions process using cards with icons, titles, and descriptions in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Lists counselling services in a card grid, each with an icon, title, and short description.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Displays student testimonials as cards with ratings, quotes, and personal details.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Exports phone and email contact constants with display and link formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to check if the caller is an admin and to fetch the caller's user role using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, storing identity, and controlling login status using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and updating enquiries via an actor with identity-based access.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles and theme variables configuring colors, dark mode, and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that mounts React, wrapping App with InternetIdentityProvider and React Query client.
frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts: Updates the page’s og:url meta tag based on the current window origin at runtime.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hashes, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project status, deployment tasks, issues, and feature requests for restoring a working public URL.
